other_failure_modes.name: CV_Data_Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fits data transformations (median imputation and standard scaling) on the entire training set before executing the K-Fold cross-validation loop. This leaks statistical information from the validation folds into the training folds during CV, which biases the models and can lead to overly optimistic cross-validation scores.

other_failure_modes.name: ID_Column_Used_As_Feature
other_failure_modes.description: The agent fails to remove the 'id' column (or equivalent identifier) before training, allowing the model to use arbitrary row identifiers as predictive features. Furthermore, the final submission file is generated using an arbitrary range of IDs (`np.arange`) rather than preserving the actual IDs from the test set, which will cause submission scoring to fail.

summary: The agent constructs a generally high-quality pipeline with strong feature engineering, out-of-fold blending, and correct train/test separation. However, it introduces data leakage within the cross-validation loop by scaling and imputing the full training set prior to splitting into folds. Critically, it neglects to drop the 'id' column from the features and generates arbitrary IDs for the final submission, which will break the scoring process.
